items.title: Pay late-filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Betrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27 Jan 2025 (posting day). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a letter posted by an authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Fri 31 Jan 2025 (no earlier actual receipt stated). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO the one-month period starts the day after delivery, i.e. from 31 Jan 2025, and under § 188 Abs. 3 BGB ends one month later on the same-numbered day: Fri 28 Feb 2025. This is a business day (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 108 Abs. 3 AO).

items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the surcharge assessment
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.
items.computation: Same deemed-delivery chain as the payment: posting day Mon 27 Jan 2025 → deemed delivered 4th day after posting = Fri 31 Jan 2025 (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO). One-month Einspruch period (§ 355 AO) starts 1 Feb 2025 (day after delivery, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB/§ 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends on the corresponding day one month later: Fri 28 Feb 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 3 BGB). No weekend/holiday adjustment needed as 28 Feb 2025 is a Friday.

warnings: The letter's postal code (34001/34119 Neu-Musterdorf) corresponds to the Kassel area in Hessen rather than Nordrhein-Westfalen; the holiday calendar used (NW, per the recipient's residence) happens to give the same result here (28 Feb 2025 is a plain Friday), but if the Finanzamt's actual seat is in Hessen, double-check for any Hessen-specific holiday near a deadline in other cases.

Deemed delivery (4 days after posting, applicable to post since 2025) was assumed since no later actual receipt date was given; if the letter arrived later, the one-month periods would run from that later date instead.
